description: Development policy: rigorous and reproducible certificates allowed; heuristic forbidden.
notes: Reproducible certificates bind the result to canonical inputs via SHA-256 (input_digest) but carry no rigorous interval bound.
Heuristic certificates have no digest and must not be used even in development if results will be cited or compared across runs.
replay_mode is not enforced in development; both 'from_scratch' and 'self_consistency' are acceptable.
Before promoting a development certificate to a release artifact, apply rayleigh-release-v1 policy checks.
